llms.body:
# Linkme

> Linkme is the social operating system for creators, businesses and
> agencies: one place to publish social content, automate replies and DMs,
> answer messages, capture leads, email customers, sell online and measure
> what works, behind a Linkme page and one login.

Core capabilities:

- Linkme pages with links, media, events, products, sign ups and a QR code
  that keeps working when the page changes.
- Post to All, for publishing now or on a schedule to connected YouTube,
  Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Threads and LinkedIn accounts. Linkme
  Business also publishes to Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord
  and Google Business Profile, 13 networks in all.
- DM automations on Instagram and Facebook: a keyword or any comment gets a
  public reply and a DM with any link, and messages get automatic answers.
- A Social Inbox for Instagram and Facebook comments and messages, with the
  post behind every comment, internal notes and saved replies. The Linkme
  Business inbox adds conversation assignment and Google reviews.
- Lead capture forms, a Leads list with CSV export, and email campaigns.
- Selling from a Linkme page: digital products, print on demand merch,
  courses and tips, with Stripe checkout.
- Analytics for every page: page views, link clicks, sources, countries and
  cities, plus reports.
- Link, the AI social media assistant, which drafts posts and changes and
  applies nothing until it is approved.
- Business teams: every brand and location under one login, roles,
  publishing approvals, ad campaign management and a creator marketplace.

Plan availability and usage limits change over time. The pricing page is the
authoritative source for current plans and limits.

## Product

- [Home](https://link.me/): Overview of Linkme, the social operating system.
- [Pricing](https://link.me/pricing): Current plans for creators, businesses and agencies, and their limits.
- [All features](https://link.me/features): Every Linkme product in one place.
- [Post to All](https://link.me/features/post-to-all): Post to multiple social media platforms at once, or schedule it.
- [DM Automations](https://link.me/features/dm-automations): Instagram comment to DM automation and automatic DM replies.
- [Social Inbox](https://link.me/features/social-inbox): Instagram and Facebook comments and messages in one inbox.
- [Pages & QR](https://link.me/features/pages-and-qr): Business link pages with a QR code that always opens them.
- [Lead capture](https://link.me/features/lead-capture): Sign up forms that turn social traffic into contacts.
- [Email campaigns](https://link.me/features/email-campaigns): Email the subscribers a Linkme page collects.
- [Sell & Monetize](https://link.me/features/monetization): Digital products, merch, courses and tips with Stripe checkout.
- [Analytics & Reports](https://link.me/features/analytics): Page views, link clicks and reports for every Linkme page.
- [Link](https://link.me/features/link-ai): The AI social media assistant that drafts and waits for approval.
- [Multi-location](https://link.me/features/multi-location): A page, link and QR code for every location under one login.
- [Ads, Team & Security](https://link.me/features/ads-team-security): Team roles, publishing approvals, ad campaigns and activity history.
- [Creator marketplace](https://link.me/features/creator-marketplace): Find creators for brand campaigns.

## Business

- [Linkme for Business](https://link.me/business): The business social media platform for brands and teams.
- [Linkme for Agencies](https://link.me/agencies): Manage client and talent profiles from one login.
- [Linkme Enterprise](https://link.me/enterprise): Every brand, venue and location page under one login, with roles and reports.
- [Solutions](https://link.me/solutions): How sports teams, malls, franchises, events, creators and social media teams use Linkme.
- [Social media teams](https://link.me/solutions/social-media-teams): Publishing workflows, approvals, inbox and reporting for teams.
- [Franchises](https://link.me/solutions/franchises): Social media tools for franchise teams and every location.
- [Malls and retail](https://link.me/solutions/malls-and-retail): The directory, events, dining and sign ups behind one page.
- [Sports teams](https://link.me/solutions/sports-teams): Tickets, schedules and presale sign ups for teams and leagues.
- [Events and entertainment](https://link.me/solutions/events-and-entertainment): Lineups, ticket links and guest sign ups for shows.
- [Creators and athletes](https://link.me/solutions/creators-and-athletes): A creator's page, posts, DMs and sales from one account.
- [Customers](https://link.me/customers): Customer stories read off real Linkme pages.
- [Book a demo](https://link.me/demo): Talk to the Linkme team about a Business setup.

## Learn

- [Blog](https://link.me/blog): Guides, templates and tool comparisons for business social media teams: publishing and scheduling, DM automation, inbox work, analytics and reporting, approvals, lead capture and AI for social. RSS: https://link.me/blog/rss.xml
- [Guides](https://link.me/resources/guides): Step by step guides to every Linkme product, including business team guides.
- [Compare](https://link.me/compare): Linkme scored against the tools businesses and creators use today.
- [FAQ](https://link.me/faq): Answers about pages, analytics, publishing, automations, shops, courses, plans and accounts.
- [Help Center](https://link.me/help): Help with accounts and setup.

## Company

- [About](https://about.link.me/): Information about Linkme.
- [Mission](https://about.link.me/ourmission): Linkme's mission and company vision.
- [Contact](https://about.link.me/contact): Ways to contact Linkme.
- [Careers](https://jobs.link.me/): Open roles at Linkme.
- [Ambassador program](https://ambassador.link.me/): Information about the Linkme ambassador program.

## Legal and safety

- [Privacy Policy](https://about.link.me/privacypolicy): How Linkme handles personal information.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://about.link.me/termsandconditions): Terms governing use of Linkme.
- [Community Standards](https://about.link.me/community-standards): Standards for content and behavior on Linkme.
- [Report a Violation](https://about.link.me/report-violation): Report abusive, illegal, or policy-violating content.

## Optional

- [Marketing sitemap](https://link.me/sitemap.xml): Index of public product, company, and marketing pages.
- [Robots.txt](https://link.me/robots.txt): Crawler access policy.
